items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He told me about Ernest Kelly, didn't he? Did they ever work together?

ctx.x: Ask him why he's got Zeb and Ernest Kelly together. Zeb was a fine fella. You see what?

He never disappointed me. He said, why come you got Zeb and Chris Kelly together? Ernest Kelly. Ernest Kelly. Well, that's not just coming to my mind, you know. Ernest Kelly. Did they work together? He told me about Ernest Kelly, didn't he? Did they ever work together? You know, that's what I told. When we were playing together, we had to get our uniform, you know. And so I asked, I asked the man, I asked the man, why did he charge me the same thing that charged Eddie? I went, Ernest. He said, well, I said, you…
Ask him, who did Zeb work with?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: We went to Mexico together. ... I should work with his next one, Ernest, with Bob Lyon.

ctx.x: Jim Kelly, yeah. Chambon. That was Ernest Kelly's anchor. We didn't know Ernest Kelly. Didn't have his name either. Yeah, I have his name. He's a trauma. Chambon, yeah. Dead fish brother. He had diabetes. He took me cutting his legs off. Took me apart.
Died. Ask him, did he ever work again with Jim Kelly.
